item.title: FAILURE
item.description: Seven times said the wolf to the kid, Cease. Only then devoured. What made me to be drawn that way to what the heart desired. Failure is a poem by Nathan Zach, translated by Rony Efrat. It was first presented as a video art in September 2014 at The Unresolved Festival at Ophelia Theatre, London, UK.

item.title: HOME CHECK
item.description: Home Check is an interactive performance that incorporates digital tools to create a virtual “home visit” experience. The performance uses video mapping and digital questionnaires to simulate the process of evaluating someone’s living space, blending personal interaction with technological mediation
